svg.text: AFTER THE WAR: THE WINDERMERE CHILDREN AIRLIFT (AUGUST 1945)
How 10 Converted RAF Heavy Bombers Flew 300 Orphaned Child Survivors from Prague to Cumbria

g.text: Flight of 10 converted RAF Short Stirling bombers
Coaches from Carlisle to Calgarth Estate, Windermere
Warplanes Turned Into Aeroplanes of Peace
Three months after VE Day, Royal Air Force bombers
flew 300 orphaned child survivors to Carlisle in
Cumbria, where hot meals, art therapy, football &
bicycles beside Lake Windermere helped them heal.
